caps_source: VeriGPU parameter defaults (lanes per warp, warps per core).
verify: NUM_LANES / NUM_WARPS parameters in the VeriGPU top module
controller command FIFO for the zero-length memcpy bug
JALR target computation in the core

#5.note: Signed branch/comparison instructions use unsigned operations, producing wrong predicates for negative operands.

#6.note: Zero-length memory copies desynchronise the controller and host runtime: later commands are misread.

#7.note: Division targeting register zero skips the writeback completion, leaving the core waiting.

#8.note: Kernel initialisation clears only register zero; register values persist across launches.

#9.note: Global memory indexing truncates store addresses, aliasing high addresses onto lower ones.

#10.note: JALR target calculation fails to clear the least significant bit.

#11.note: The floating-point adder lacks NaN and opposing-infinity handling: invalid operations return zero.

#12.note: Incorrect floating-point overflow handling produces a NaN pattern instead of the rounded overflow result.

#13.note: The floating-point multiplier mishandles zero multiplied by infinity, returning zero instead of NaN.

notes: Parameters are starting points taken from each project's documented defaults. They are data: adjust caps to the configuration you elaborate, then run `python3 cli.py doctor --target verigpu`.
